original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can scripts/experiments/disjoint_tensor.py:DisjointTensor.frame_data replace its per-node reachable-target bit enumeration with equivalent exact target-union propagation (as proved opt-in in research/disjoint-frame-unions / #1044) so verify_frames receipts, descendant bitsets, source unions and rectangle require() checks stay fieldwise identical on the historical h=26 circuit?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after merged #2001 left DisjointTensor.verify_frames / frame_data as an explicit open question; profiling named the historical bit-enumeration loop in frame_data (~1.8s of ~2.2s verify_frames on h=26) as the next unclaimed hot path. The #1044 opt-in adapter is not the default production path.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: disjoint-tensor-compression, ternary-side, dyadic-central-factor and parity-side certificates call DisjointTensor.verify_frames. A faster identical frame_data does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production frame_data change with frozen baseline, identical verify_frames receipts on the historical h=26 circuit, updated source pins only on the four binding certificates, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa, do not touch ternary_side.py / audit_joint_frames.py, and do not run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_DISJOINT_TENSOR_FRAME_UNIONS via research/disjoint-tensor-frame-unions/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_DISJOINT_TENSOR_FRAME_UNION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; four certificates differ from base only in the scripts/experiments/disjoint_tensor.py source pin.
author: Wentao Li
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, implementation, packaging, benchmarking and writing. Not independent human peer review.
